record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, retain the existing pairwise-plus-0.2-pointwise loss but weight each nonpadding target by 0.95^(number of later nonpadding targets), dividing the weighted sum by the sum of weights. Emphasizing recent prediction positions may align training with next-item evaluation while retaining supervision from earlier prefixes. Keep sampling, embeddings, GRU topology, readout, scoring, optimizer and training settings fixed.

     loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
-    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)

category_rationales.rationale: Weight each nonpadding target by 0.95 raised to the number of later nonpadding targets, emphasizing recent prefixes while retaining the existing pairwise-plus-0.2-pointwise objective across all four datasets. Architecture and predictor shapes remain unchanged.
